notes: General ratings are absolute FIFA-anchored scores with StatsBomb season adjustment capped to a few points.
Recent ratings are General plus a bounded form adjustment from actual event data in the five latest team matches.
Tracking-style physical data is synthetic; FIFA height/pace/acceleration/sprint/stamina/strength/jumping are source attributes.

provenance.fifa: public FIFA16/SoFIFA-derived dataset; Brad Smith fallback is synthetic
provenance.recent: actual StatsBomb events from each team's last five league matches before target match
